name: Guacamole
description: A fresh and simple guacamole recipe made with chilled avocado, lime juice, and minced Spanish onion.

recipeInstructions.text: Mash the chilled avocado in a bowl.
Stir in lime juice and minced Spanish onion until well combined.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

_similar.name: Chili Con Queso (Nacho Cheese Dip)
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy dip made with cream cheese, cheddar cheese soup, and processed cheese, perfect for tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can (284 mL) cheddar cheese soup

recipeInstructions.text: Let the cream cheese stand at room temperature to warm up.
In a saucepan, melt the cream cheese over heat.
Add the cheddar cheese soup, stirring constantly until well combined.
Crumble the processed cheese into smaller pieces and melt it into the cheese mixture.
Add salsa to taste, adjusting the amount based on the type of salsa used.
Serve the Chili Con Queso hot with tortilla chips as a dip, or cold with tacos or chili.

_similar.keywords: nacho cheese dip, chili con queso, cheesy dip, tortilla chip dip

_similar.name: Hot Taco Dip
_similar.description: A warm, layered taco dip featuring seasoned ground beef, sour cream, and melted cheddar cheese, served with tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 package Old El Paso taco seasoning mix

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with chopped onion in a frying pan; drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning mix to the browned hamburger and prepare according to package directions.
In a 13x9x2 inch baking dish, spread the prepared hamburger mixture evenly across the bottom.
Sprinkle the chopped green peppers on top of the hamburger layer.
Mix together the sour cream and cream cheese (if using) until smooth.
Spread the sour cream mixture over the top of the green peppers.
Spread a layer of mild salsa over the sour cream layer.
Top with a layer of grated cheddar cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F until heated through.
Serve hot with tortilla chips.

_similar.keywords: hot taco dip, taco dip, Mexican appetizer, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip

_similar.name: Mexican Fudge
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy baked appetizer served on Triscuits.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup taco or salsa sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Grease a 9×11 in pan and spread the cheddar cheese evenly on the bottom.
Lightly beat the eggs and mix with taco or salsa sauce.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheddar cheese.
Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm and serve on Triscuits.

_similar.keywords: Mexican fudge, baked cheese dip, salsa appetizer, cheesy squares
